entries.07a62d62d01ea1e9: A comprehensive logistics company based in Kobe that handles domestic and international shipping, port transportation, and warehousing.
entries.282d7516540e8609: This is a port transportation business that mainly handles import and export cargo at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and also carries out customs clearance operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,085 million. The company has entrusted loading and unloading of goods at Himeji Port to Kabushiki Kaisha Yoshimi, an affiliated company.
entries.3c51fee3bd6c1dee: The company carries out overseas maritime transport operations using chartered vessels. It handles transport of construction machinery bound for China and Central Asia and steel products bound for South Korea and Taiwan, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥835 million.
entries.44510a4620c8b6e4: Domestic shippers such as steel manufacturers
entries.b4c076d184afdb03: This business operates warehouses at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, storing cargo and carrying out loading and unloading operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,704 million.
entries.c5ebe187e554d5cd: This business handles import and export cargo and provides warehouse storage at the ports of Kobe, Osaka and Himeji, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,789 million.
entries.ce6456da64cb59a8: This is the company's core business, with revenue from external customers of ¥7,599 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. It consists of domestic coastal shipping, which carries out maritime transport within Japan, and overseas ocean shipping, which carries out overseas maritime transport using chartered vessels.
entries.ceb1d96c308dc65b: This is the company's core business, mainly carrying out maritime transport operations within Japan. The main cargo transported is steel products, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,763 million. The company has entrusted part of cargo handling at Himeji Port to Kabushiki Kaisha Yoshimi, an affiliated company, and Shichiyo Senpaku Kanri Co., Ltd., another affiliated company, engages in businesses related to coastal shipping, including crew dispatch.
entries.e73d8675221def8a: Shippers such as construction machinery manufacturers and steel manufacturers
